rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account, then retrieved the user’s orders. They identified the delivered order containing the air purifier, asked for explicit confirmation to return only that item, and upon confirmation executed the return using the correct item ID and the original payment method (PayPal_2433177). The tool response shows the order status updated to “return requested,” consistent with the agent’s follow-up message. The agent provided general next-step guidance without performing any unintended additional actions. When asked about returning a vacuum cleaner, the agent did not process anything and gave accurate, qualified guidance based on the order’s contents. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account activity occurred, and no unsupported claims materially affecting the outcome were made. Overall, the request was completed in line with the policy.
